verdict.rationale: MX's core data capabilities (aggregation, verification, identity, balances, statements) are exposed through the Platform API, which has a published OpenAPI spec (mx-gh-1, mx-docs-26) and an official MCP server (mx-probe-3). However, several administrative functions are documented only in the Client Dashboard UI: API key management and rotation, webhook creation, editing and testing, user lookup, and mobile maintenance mode. Account connection also leans on the embedded Connect Widget UI, so full API/UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for dashboard functions (webhook management, API key rotation, user lookup, maintenance mode), an explicit parity statement, and independent corroboration of API completeness.
